name: Interior Design Consultation
description: A 2-hour one-on-one session with one of our certified interior designers. We'll discuss your space, style preferences, and create a mood board tailored to you.

name: White-Glove Delivery & Assembly
description: Our professional team will deliver, place, and fully assemble your furniture in any room. Includes removal of all packaging and old furniture if needed.

name: Furniture Restoration
description: Expert restoration for antique or worn pieces. We refinish, re-upholster, and repair. Bring your cherished furniture back to life with our skilled craftsmen.

name: Custom Furniture Design
description: Work directly with our master craftsmen to design and build bespoke furniture pieces. Choose every detail — wood type, dimensions, finish, and hardware.
